COD.note: A tender with a sovereign-cloud option for video conferencing only; no goal, rule or hosting of state data stated.
Technical specifications cite standards for equipment only; no standards body membership or adoption stated.

facts.fact: The Digital Transformation Project unit issued a tender notice on 4 June 2026, financed by a World Bank credit and AFD co-financing, to connect administrative buildings of 7 governorates and 44 territories in a pilot phase over a GovNet VPN, with bids due 16 July 2026.
The pilot connection tender is financed by World Bank credit 7602-ZR and an AFD co-financing agreement, with no domestic budget line stated.

systems.platform: satellite LEO, microwave, fibre or mobile links with IPSec VPN to a Kinshasa hub

COD.note: No data centre for hire stated.
